name: AOC AGON PRO AG276QZD2
A_response_avg: 0.50 ms G2G średnio, najlepszy 0.34 ms (tftcentral.co.uk/reviews/aoc-agon-pro-ag276qzd2). RTINGS: liczby za paywallem; 'near-instant response time'
B_vrr_flicker: TFTCentral: 'some familiar flickering in darker content, triggered especially in situations with large frame rate swings'; brak trybów anti-flicker. RTINGS 'Cons': 'Distracting VRR flicker'
B_bfi: Brak BFI: 'Sadly there is no BFI blur reduction mode on this screen' (tftcentral)
C_subpixel: Gen 3 QD-OLED, 'triangular shaped RGB sub-pixel layout' (tftcentral)
C_text_fringing: TFTCentral: 'more pixel fill than older panels... improving text rendering a bit'; 'didn't really experience any major issues with office and general use'
D_hdr_peak: TFTCentral (10% APL): tryb DisplayHDR 408 nitów; HDR Peak 875 nitów; HDR Picture/Movie/Game 910 nitów. Okna 2%/100% — BRAK. RTINGS: 'small highlights are bright enough to pop'
D_eotf: TFTCentral: DisplayHDR — 'pretty good tracking of the PQ EOTF overall... a little darker than intended in darker grey shades'; HDR Peak — 'a bit darker than intended across most of the greyscale'; HDR Picture/Movie/Game — 'much higher than intended'
E_delta_e: TFTCentral: tryb natywny — greyscale do dE 5.7 max, 6233K, gamma ~2.2; tryb sRGB emulation — dE 2.3 śr. (6149K, gamma 2.25); DCI-P3 — dE 2.2. Średnia dE trybu domyślnego DO WERYFIKACJI (5.4 vs ABSENT w dwóch ekstraktach). Gamut: sRGB 141.8% rel., DCI-P3 113.1% rel., Adobe RGB 98.2% abs. RTINGS: 'much more accurate colors before calibration' niż AW2726DM
E_input_lag: 0.10 ms total display lag @240 Hz; 15.70 ms @60 Hz (tftcentral). RTINGS: 'Low input lag at max refresh rate', 'higher at 60Hz and 120Hz'
E_coating: 'semi glossy' z filmem AR; 'retains most of the clear and crisp picture quality of a fully glossy solution' (tftcentral). RTINGS: 'Ambient light causes black levels to rise'
F_burn_in: 3-letnia gwarancja 'including burn-in cover'; Pixel Orbiting, Pixel Refresh, Screen Saver, logo protection, boundary dimmer, taskbar dimmer, thermal protection (tftcentral)
notes: RTINGS: Mar 31, 2025 (Test Bench 2.1.2), firmware V109 — frame skipping usunięty po G-MENU V3.28.0; 'Very limited HDR color gamut and volume' jak na QD-OLED. TechSpot: tylko starszy AG276QZD (WOLED) — nieużyte.
